agency.name: Behavioral Health Division, Wyoming Department of Health

narrNote: Wyoming has no affiliate on NARR's official affiliate list (checked 2026-10-22). Recovery residences that accept public housing funds in Wyoming certify through the Wyoming Department of Health's own state standards process instead of a NARR affiliate.
notes: Agency phone is null: the Wyoming Department of Health site bot-walls content scraping, and no divisional phone number could be confirmed from fetched content in-run, so none is published rather than risk a wrong number. Medicaid SUD URL is WDH's official BHC Benefit Plans page: since July 1, 2024, Wyoming's Behavioral Health Redesign delivers outpatient and residential mental health and substance use disorder treatment through contracted Behavioral Health Centers under the BHC-Screen and BHC-Full benefit plans, and those centers enroll as Wyoming Medicaid providers. County directory is null per verification doctrine: the Wyoming County Commissioners Association site (wyocounty.com) was unreachable in two separate in-run fetch attempts, and no alternate official county directory URL could be verified. Recover Wyoming is the state's recovery community organization and partners with WDH on Certified Peer Specialist training.
